description: Two horizontally separated rows. Each row has a thin gray horizontal connector line with small circular glyphs placed on it. Top row contains three multi-slice pie-like circles; bottom row contains two small gray nodes on the left and one pie-like circle on the right.

components.description: Top row region with one horizontal line and three small multi-slice circular pies aligned on the line.
Thin horizontal connector line spanning the row.
Left pie glyph composed of multiple colored arc slices.
Center pie glyph composed of multiple colored arc slices.
Right pie glyph composed of multiple colored arc slices.
Bottom row region with one horizontal line, two small gray circular nodes on the left, and one pie glyph on the right.
Thin horizontal connector line spanning the row.
Two small solid gray circular nodes positioned on the left segment of the line.
Right pie glyph composed of multiple colored arc slices.

primary.explanation: A single horizontal connector line spanning the bottom row; treated as one item along x.
One pie glyph split into three slices laid out around the full angle.
Multiple slices of one pie arranged around the angle dimension.
The pie is composed of multiple arc slices distributed around the full circle; we model 4 slices.
A single horizontal connector line spanning the bottom row; treated as one item along x.
Two small gray circular nodes arranged horizontally on the left segment of the line.
One pie glyph subdivided into multiple slices around the angle; estimated 4 slices from the design.
